<message>
My girlfriend broke up with me. Although I know it's the best outcome for both of us, I still can't let it go.
</message>
output: I keep telling myself it was the right call, but my chest doesn't believe it yet. I think I'm scared of what it means to actually let go, like I'll lose the last piece of her if I do. Part of me just wants the ache to stop without having to admit it's really over.
